tasks.title: Keep nested Settings content and action labels readable on enlarged phones
tasks.body:
Goal:
Keep Settings content and action labels readable in nested phone cards.

Current behavior:
Current360-pixel200-percent Settings screenshots show cumulative card/action/sync-status padding shrinking text into narrow columns. Export and Upload action words split final letters. The private-section static fixture extracts only the inner list and misses the actual nested geometry. Existing outer document and target checks do not detect intact ordinary action words.

Desired behavior:
Use available phone width for nested Settings content, sync section names and fixed action labels. Retain44-pixel primary targets and exact controls. Keep current section order; separate frozen Settings section-navigation task owns information architecture.

Touch:
- `src/Habitica.WebApp/wwwroot/css/app.css`
- `tests/Habitica.WebApp.Tests/Pages/SettingsPageTests.cs`
- `tests/browser-qualification/ux-ui-workspace-names-journey.mjs`
- `tests/browser-qualification/ux-ui-settings-reflow-journey.mjs`
- `tests/browser-qualification/ux-ui-adapters.json`

Implementation constraints:
No font/zoom reduction, hidden labels, action removal or backup/source/consent/permission behavior changes. Preserve destructive and original command safeguards. Existing local synthetic build/test authorization applies. No provider, upload, restore, destructive or real account operation is authorized. Physical devices, native file dialogs and assistive technology remain unqualified.

Validation:
Retain original full-route screenshot as the failing rendered regression. Capture owning Settings markup and run existing meaningful Settings tests. Native Range per-word line checks cover actual visible action labels; section names retain available ordinary-word area. Qualify all declared widths, normal/enlarged text and light/dark schemes including obsidian-glow. Toggle exact private sections independently and restore originals; preserve task journal and owned cleanup.
